data.headline: Early childhood education, activity planning and parent communication
data.summary: They plan preschool activities, lead nature-based learning projects, support children through transitions and communicate with parents. They use Wilma and Daisy for parent messages and attendance records.

signals.rendering: They work with a preschool group of six-year-old children at a daycare centre.
They plan weekly activities according to the early childhood education curriculum.
They lead projects where children collect leaves and practise counting and sorting them.
They create picture schedules with children to support transitions between activities.
They give parents weekly updates and send messages through digital tools.
They use Wilma for parent communication and attendance records.
They use Daisy for parent communication and attendance records.
